g.text: Use A = 2:1 and B = 4:2. B selects four copies, but its cosize is 7, so the candidate repeat pool must include tile ids 0..6.
B(r) = 2r, so B selects tile ids 0, 2, 4, 6
candidate_repeat_layout(tile_id) gives the starting offset for each possible copy of A.
2. Select repeats with B, then form the product
Flattened offset space: selected copies occupy four separated 2-element tiles
